tasks.title: Carry producer request separately from invocation in execution state
tasks.goal: Make scoped reuse depend on meaningful production inputs and exact target context.
steps: Use M-14 target and M-16 operation carriers instead of ambient project-only identity.
Implement distinct production-request/invocation digests and persist them through state/header/execution records.
Frame selected work and actually consumed captured inputs; exclude unrelated registry accumulation and observer invocation identity.
positive_cases: Create-to-verify keeps the completed producer identity stable.
Changing selected source/world/consumed input changes the request.
negative_cases: Different target root/principal or another change cannot replay old state.
Unrelated artifact insertion cannot spuriously invalidate production.

steps: Update generated context/task/outbox/resume contracts with exact target, request and continuation bindings.
Emit and validate hosted tasks through the same schema; retain safe source/output witnesses.
Refuse old/foreign/mismatched task replies with a structured reason and keep current parked work recoverable.
positive_cases: Exact hosted reply resumes only its matching continuation.
negative_cases: Cross-change/node reply, edited intent or old wire epoch never gets retagged.

tasks.title: Bind artifact and verification evidence to scoped operations
tasks.goal: Preserve pre/post meaning through records, reports and external results.
steps: Bind artifact/evidence IDs and reports to exact production request, subject and admitted target.
Represent historical pre-state, transition completion and current post-state as different evidence fields.
Carry partial errors, plan/report events and operation identity through M-16 services without changing neutral fact semantics.
positive_cases: Verification report explains which current output and captured input each witness concerns.
negative_cases: Pre-dispatch measurements cannot be renamed post-source success.
An error after a recorded effect cannot appear not-executed.
